title.en: State-derived playback with pause and reset

summary: Display a sequence without letting animation create a second conflicting source of state.
objective: Display a sequence without letting animation create a second conflicting source of state.
example_prompts: Use state-derived playback with pause and reset for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Choose whether state commits before, during or after a transition and keep that policy consistent.
Distinguish a recorded sequence from a solver that can accept arbitrary new states.
implementation: Keep committed model state, pending actions and presentation progress separate.
Define cancellation, queueing and undo behavior while a transition is active.
Reset clears pending work and presentation progress before restoring the initial model.
observable_checks: Pause preserves both transition progress and committed state.
Reset during a transition prevents delayed callbacks from applying old actions.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
